services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: Looking for a personal trainer in Koreatown? Train 1-on-1 with Coach Kevin Kim - Level 3 Trainer, HYROX Coach and CAMTC recovery therapist - at Wilshire & Western, one block from the Metro. Personal training at K2 is a program built around one person: you. Sixty-minute sessions, a plan written for your goal, and a coach whose eyes are on your form for every rep. Whether that goal is losing 20 lbs, fixing your posture, your first pull-up, or a HYROX start line, this is the fastest route we know. K2 has coached Koreatown since 2017. Sessions run mornings, lunchtime and evenings on weekdays, plus weekend mornings - and if you hold a membership, the recovery floor - cupping, NormaTec, infrared
